name: ChirpStack
description: ChirpStack is an open-source LoRaWAN Network Server. It manages gateways, devices and applications, handles device activation and the LoRaWAN MAC layer, and forwards uplink data to MQTT, HTTP and many other integrations.

app_vars.name: var_region
app_vars.label: Gateway Region ID
app_vars.help: ChirpStack region ID used as MQTT topic prefix by the Gateway Bridge, for example eu868, us915_0 or as923_2.

notes.text: Change the default admin password after the first login.
The install asks for the gateway region ID (e.g. eu868, us915_0); unattended installs must set var_region. It must be listed in enabled_regions in /etc/chirpstack/chirpstack.toml.
